messages:
Maria Chen: FYI — Nimbus Telecom POC is blocked by two enterprise asks: on‑prem pilot + data residency + a legal IP clause. They want exec alignment on pricing and timeline asap. Deal at ~$1.2M ACV if we can meet this. Can we get an exec sync? @Samir P., @Ajay S., @Nikhil R.
Samir Patel: Ack. What are the technical constraints? QPS / context length / SLA?
Maria Chen: Customer profile: peak ~200 QPS, 8k token contexts, strict 99.9% SLA requirement, EU data residency. They insist on either on‑prem or a private deployment in their VPC with KMS integration.
Ajay Singh: On‑prem pilot will need infra + security team time. Realistic timeline 6–8 weeks to ship a hardened package. For quick demo we could do a dedicated-hosted pilot scoped to their VPC/region. That would buy time.
Emily Torres: I can assemble the SSO/KMS checklist and a quick runbook for a hybrid demo. I asked Nimbus to start the security questionnaire (sent link).
Nikhil Rao: We can carve a Dedicated pool, but need resource approval for GPUs and ops bandwidth. Can we quantify expected infra cost? Ops, would need a ballpark (monthly).
Maria Chen: Sales asked for two asks from execs: 1) approval to offer a 3‑month pilot discount/credit 2) signoff on a short on‑prem commitment template if they push for it. Also they want CTO/CRO on a call this week.
OpsBot: Created ticket INC-4321 for infra feasibility review and capacity estimate (assignee: eng-infra).
Samir Patel: Proposal: offer hosted dedicated in EU region for initial POC (isolated pool + VPN peering) so they can run some traffic immediately. Meanwhile the on‑prem package is negotiated. This reduces time to demo to 1 week.
Ajay Singh: VPN peering + dedicated pool is fine for demo, but for audit/compliance they will still request private deployment. Pricing needs to reflect the hybrid: pilot credit + conversion discount.
Nikhil Rao: I'll escalate to CTO and ops leadership — need a short brief. Can someone prep a 1‑pager with risks/cost and proposed terms? I can get exec time Tue 10:00am PST.
Maria Chen: I will draft the 1‑pager and include the customer's security questionnaire link + expected QPS. Sending invite once draft done.
Emily Torres: Quick technical note to include in brief:
```
- Peak QPS: 200
- Avg seq len: 4k tokens, peak 8k
- SLA target: 99.9%
- Required: EU residency, SSO (SAML), KMS + audit logs
```
Jen Lewis: Legal will need to review NDAs and the IP clause. I'll start a fast‑track review but need the proposed pilot terms.
Maria Chen: Thanks all — immediate asks: (1) Samir/Emily please confirm demo plan for hosted dedicated by EOD (2) Ajay/Nikhil please confirm capacity + approval path and whether ops can support Tue exec sync.
Samir Patel: Will confirm demo plan by EOD.
Ajay Singh: I'll surface capacity estimate by EOD and flag any blockers.
Nikhil Rao: I'll confirm exec availability for Tue after I loop in CTO.
Maria Chen: Great — scheduling followups. :calendar:
